text.tspan: Annual economic damages from all natural disasters excluding extreme
temperatures as a share of GDP World, 2000 to 2025
Damages are expressed as a share of gross domestic product (GDP). Disasters include events such as earthquakes,
volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical
and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); National statistical organizations and central banks, OECD national accounts, and World
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
